name: AI Optical / CPO
thesis: AI cluster scale-up expands optical interconnect and CPO demand, shifting constraints and beneficiary opportunities across the value chain.
questions: Where are the near-term optical and CPO bottlenecks?
Which suppliers could benefit if those bottlenecks tighten?
Which adjacent links should be expanded after evidence collection?
limitations: Intake is a starting hypothesis; no candidate is confirmed without evidence.
